tells: 1. Face close is a game cutscene: waxy orange diffuse skin with no pore/specular breakup, painted-on eyes with no wet catchlight, rubbery lip line, and a dark matte halo outlining head and shoulders where the DOF composite separates subject from background (club-4-face.png, whole frame, esp. jaw/shoulder edge and left blonde's outline)

2. Light is unmotivated: front rows are evenly lit at face height as if by an invisible soft key from camera, while the only visible sources are tiny candles and dim sconces; candles cast no warm uplight on chins, hands or table tops (club-1-wide.png, centre tables; club-6-held.png, hands around candle)

3. Back crowd is flat black cut-out silhouettes with identical value and no rim or haze interaction, reading as a matte painting, not people in smoke (club-1-wide.png, middle band behind the seated rows; club-2-mid.png, upper left)

4. Hands float on table tops with no contact shadow or pressure, and tables/chairs share one untextured maroon plastic material with no wear or specular from the candles (club-6-held.png, centre table hands; club-3-mid.png, foreground tables)

5. Laugh strip has almost no body motion: across 1 s only one woman raises a hand and heads turn a few degrees; no shoulder heave, no torso rock, the rest are frozen mannequins (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front row)

1. Wide reads as stacked sprites: back rows are flat-lit cut-outs floating above seats in a grid, figures at the far left/right standing in mid-air, no seat backs occluding bodies, no falloff with depth (theatre-1-wide.png, upper two-thirds and left/right edges)

2. Face close: mouth is an open black hole with no teeth or tongue detail, skin is uniform peach plastic, hair is a solid helmet, earrings are clean CG hoops; grade looks like 2008 game render (theatre-4-face.png, mouth and hairline)

3. Lighting has no source logic: a house this dark would show stage spill falling off row by row, but all foreground figures get the same flat front fill and the back rows are lit by nothing yet remain visible; background points of light are lens-less specks with no flare or bloom shape (theatre-1-wide.png, front two rows vs. back; theatre-2-mid.png, top)

4. Grounding fails: people sit on rather than in seats, legs and feet vanish into black with no floor, red seats have no geometry or shading, bodies clip through the row in front (theatre-3-mid.png, front row legs and seats; theatre-6-held.png, lower right man)

5. Identical character models repeat across the house (same teal hoodie, same purple top, same blonde bun) and the strip shows near-static poses with only small mouth/head changes, no laugh-driven shoulders or leaning (theatre-5-strip.png, all frames; theatre-1-wide.png, front rows)

1. Face close still reads CG: smooth airbrushed skin with no texture at this magnification, hair is a textured shell with jagged card edge, eyes lack moisture and lid shadow, and the cutout halo/dark fringe around head and background figures betrays a depth-based composite (openmic-4-face.png, hairline, ear and right blonde figure outline)

2. Exposure is inconsistent with the room: the visible ceiling pin-spots are behind and above the crowd, yet faces are evenly front-filled from camera position with no backlight rim on hair or shoulders (openmic-1-wide.png, front row faces vs. ceiling lights; openmic-6-held.png)

3. Pin-spots render as perfect round soft discs with no lens character (no streak, no aperture shape, no flare) and a green exit light floats as a blob; the back wall is a smooth CG gradient (openmic-3-mid.png, top band and green blob)

4. Bodies stand/hover rather than sit: the right man and front row have knees and hips with no chair compression, hands rest on thighs with no shadow, legs fade into black without floor contact (openmic-1-wide.png, lower third; openmic-6-held.png, right man in red jacket)

5. Laugh strip is the most alive of the three (heads turn, women lean in and smile) but it is still head and mouth only; shoulders, hands and torsos stay locked, everyone's timing is similar, and the back rows do not react at all (openmic-5-strip.png, frames t=12.6 to 13.0)
